objective: Check whether a publicly accessible conference reproduction of Grune et al. (2014) contains the complete pressure-decay inset needed to evaluate the already frozen source model.
claim_boundary: Figure-derived diagnostic for the same 20 MPa, 0.37 L, 4 mm valve case; it is not a new experiment, not a rights-cleared raw logger archive, and cannot support station, ignition, dispersion, radiation or safety-distance claims.

source.title: Experimental study of ignited unsteady hydrogen releases from a high pressure reservoir
source.figure: Figure 2 inset, Pressure decay in the vessel
source.reported_case: 4 mm nozzle, 200 bar initial pressure, 0.37 dm3 vessel
source.rights_boundary: Only derived coordinates and extraction metadata are retained; the source PDF is not committed or redistributed. Reuse/licence terms for the plot itself were not independently established.

extraction.method: PyMuPDF vector-path extraction of the red 4 mm valve curve from the embedded inset; plot axis bounds were read from the vector frame, then mapped linearly to t=0..0.5 s and P=0..200 bar.
extraction.curve_identity: red 4 mm valve path; the main-plot legend identifies this curve as the valve case

decision.reason: The route provides a complete public figure-derived curve and exposes the missing half-pressure endpoint, but it is not a rights-cleared machine-readable raw archive and is a secondary reproduction of the same experiment.
decision.next_use: Use as a transparent post-outcome completeness diagnostic; if adopted into the paper, label it figure-derived and retain the original 51-point result alongside it.
